description: This file contains the implementation of the EmployeeService class within the OrangeHRM project. It provides methods for managing employee data, including CRUD operations, event dispatching, subordinate and supervisor relations, and various utility functions specific to employee entities.

classes.name: EmployeeService
classes.description: Service class for handling employee data and related operations such as creating, updating, deleting, and retrieving employee records, as well as dispatching relevant events and managing subordinate-supervisor relationships.

methods.name: getEmployeeDao
methods.description: Retrieves the EmployeeDao instance, creating it if necessary.

methods.name: setEmployeeDao
methods.description: Sets the EmployeeDao instance.

methods.name: getEmployeeEventService
methods.description: Retrieves the EmployeeEventService instance, creating it if necessary.

methods.name: getEmployeeTerminationService
methods.description: Retrieves the EmployeeTerminationService instance, creating it if necessary.

methods.name: getIDGeneratorService
methods.description: Retrieves the IDGeneratorService instance, creating it if necessary.

methods.name: getEmployeeList
methods.description: Returns a list of employees matching the given search filter parameters.

methods.name: getEmployeeCount
methods.description: Returns the count of employees matching the given search filter parameters.

methods.name: saveEmployee
methods.description: Saves the given Employee entity and dispatches an EmployeeSavedEvent.

methods.name: saveNewEmployee
methods.description: Increments the employee ID counter and saves a new employee.

methods.name: dispatchAddEmployeeEvent
methods.description: Dispatches an event indicating a new employee has been added.

methods.name: updateEmployeePersonalDetails
methods.description: Updates personal details of an employee and dispatches an event.

methods.name: updateEmployeeJobDetails
methods.description: Updates job details of an employee and dispatches an event.

methods.name: dispatchJoinedDateChangedEvent
methods.description: Dispatches an event when an employee's joined date changes.

methods.name: getEmployeeByEmpNumber
methods.description: Retrieves an employee by their employee number.

methods.name: getNumberOfEmployees
methods.description: Returns the total number of employees, optionally including terminated ones.

methods.name: getSubordinateIdListBySupervisorId
methods.description: Returns a list of employee numbers of subordinates under a supervisor, optionally including chain and respecting max depth.

methods.name: getSubordinateList
methods.description: Returns a list of subordinate Employee entities under a supervisor.

methods.name: isSupervisor
methods.description: Checks if an employee is a supervisor.

methods.name: deleteEmployees
methods.description: Deletes employees with the given employee numbers and dispatches an EmployeesDeleted event.

methods.name: getSupervisorIdListBySubordinateId
methods.description: Returns a list of supervisor employee numbers for a subordinate, optionally including the chain.

methods.name: getEmployeeAsArray
methods.description: Returns employee data as an associative array, normalized via EmployeeModel.

methods.name: getAvailableEmployeesForWorkShift
methods.description: Returns employees available for a work shift based on search filters.

methods.name: getUndeletableEmpNumbers
methods.description: Returns employee numbers that cannot be deleted (e.g., current user and default admin in demo mode).

methods.name: isUniqueEmail
methods.description: Checks whether an email is unique among employees, considering current email if provided.

methods.name: isUniqueEmployeeId
methods.description: Checks whether an employee ID is unique among employees, considering current ID if provided.
